_comment: Explicit coverage decisions for tools/asset_coverage.py (#624). Globs are relative to potential_assets/ (`**/` spans folders, `*` stays in one) and apply only to PNGs that no SLICES.json, registry row or path rule already classified. `pending_rulings` holds usable art waiting on a named decision: reported first in docs/asset-coverage.md, never a --check failure, never excluded, and checked before `exclusions`. `exclusions` holds what is not pool material; `class` records a rig, ui or audio file the path words cannot see, otherwise the PNG is `excluded`. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.
